The reference skill in this repo was machine-generated by a deep-research
workflow run, not hand-written. There are two representations of the
research: a curated note graph (the good one) and a raw transcript archive
copied out of the rotating logs before they aged out.

**Why:** the skill cites sources by name only; the per-claim URLs live in
the notes, not in the skill itself.
